content.short: Index Coop is a DeFi DAO that creates and manages diversified crypto index products and structured assets.
content.description:
Index Coop is a leading decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) focused on making crypto investing accessible through diversified index products and structured financial assets. By aggregating top-tier protocols into single-token exposures, such as the DeFi Pulse Index (DPI) and the Metaverse Index (MVI), the platform allows users to gain broad market exposure with a single transaction. This approach simplifies the investment process, reduces gas costs, and provides institutional-grade asset management to retail participants in a non-custodial and transparent manner.

Governed by the INDEX token, the community-led protocol continuously researches and launches new products tailored to various sectors of the decentralized economy. Operating across Ethereum, Polygon, and Arbitrum, Index Coop provides a robust and interoperable framework for on-chain asset management. Through its focus on professional index construction and decentralized governance, Index Coop is a key pillar of the DeFi ecosystem, empowering users to build and manage diversified portfolios with ease.
content.meta: Index Coop provides diversified crypto index tokens and decentralized asset management tools for the Web3 ecosystem.
